title: trace review rubric entry
description: One panelist's review of one bundle, per SPEC §5b. Each file under eval/reviews/*.json is a single review. Aggregation walks the directory. is_example: true entries are excluded from aggregation by default so the seed directory cannot contaminate panel results.

panelist_id.description: Pseudonymous panelist identifier. Not a real name; a stable token. Required so inter-rater metrics can group multiple reviews by the same reviewer.

panel_id.description: Optional grouping for a given review session / cohort.

needed_external_access.description: Did the panelist open a browser tab, rebuild locally, or consult anything outside the bundle to reach a decision?

missing_evidence.description: Free-form list of what the bundle failed to supply.

primary_rejection_reason.description: Required when decision != merge. Stable enum so rejection reason can be counted across panels over time.

is_example.description: True for seed/example reviews that do not contribute to aggregation. False for real panel reviews.
